sin.name: next-task-outside-assigner
sin.description: Code outside a task assigner reads auto mode or picks the next open task, so a second place decides what the agent takes next.
sin.rule: Only a task assigner picks and starts the next task, and only an assigner reads auto mode for it. A state names its assigner; the engine asks it at a stop and when a task closes. A reader or a line takes the assigner's pure queries, such as DefaultTaskAssigner.offered or OrchestratorTaskAssigner.delegable_tasks.
